pattern: Do not state an unverified claim as a fact.
criterion: Do not state an unverified claim as a fact.

lesson.title: Avoid promising completed order details without verification
lesson.when: A customer asks for a callback and requests not to repeat information, but required order details remain incomplete or unconfirmed
lesson.do: Confirm only the callback time scheduled and state that saved details will be reviewed, without claiming order details are fully saved or ready for immediate ordering
lesson.otherwise: State clearly that specific missing details may still need to be confirmed during the call
